 For our little ones: bring a stuffed toy and cheer for the "falcons"
 "All collected toys will be donated to children in daycare and resource centers throughout Montenegro, as a small sign of attention, support and a message that they are not alone," added FSCG.
 1079 views 0 comment(s) 
 Photo: Reuters 
 Disclaimer: The translations are mostly done through AI translator and might not be 100% accurate. 
 K 
 KB 
 12.11.2026. 13:29h 
 Podgorica is ready for a football spectacle in the rain - tonight at 8:45 PM, the Montenegrin football players welcome Latvia in the 5th round of the C2 group of the League of Nations.
 "Falcons" are expecting an extremely important match on their way to League B, the third seed in the draw for the qualifying groups for the European Championship and a practically assured play-off for Euro 2028. But, apart from the competitive aspect, this match will also have a humanitarian character.
 The Football Association of Montenegro invited fans who will watch the match near Gorica to bring a stuffed toy and, as they stated, to be part of an action that combines sport, humanity and love. 
 "All collected toys will be donated to children in daycare and resource centers throughout Montenegro, as a small sign of attention, support and a message that they are not alone," added FSCG.
 View this post in the Instagram app 
 A post shared by the Football Association of Montenegro (@fscg_official) 
 After four rounds in the League of Nations, Montenegro holds first place in the group with 10 points, and could advance to League B as early as tonight if Cyprus does not defeat Armenia away.
